bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 2, 3, 6, 7. ALMANZAS presents in search of a hat-trick, fourth up. He has had the foundation which should allow him to relish the distance rise which now awaits. BONCAPO did all but win within this distance range at Dubbo on heavy ground. This race will be within his reach, aided by the claim for Izzy Neale. GRANDE DIABLO kept trying in the same race which was last contested at Dubbo by BONCAPO and GRANDE DIABLO must be treated with respect here. IMMORTAL ROSE will also be in search of a hat-trick and after leading throughout over this distance last start at Quirindi, she can be expected to now maintain her form.

HEAPY'S LEGACY appreciated the gear changes made at Quirindi when he scored last start with Mikayla Weir aboard. He can make his presence felt again today with Mikayla retaining the ride. CALZINO was kept fresh before he was solid in the same Quirindi race which was last contested by HEAPY'S LEGACY. He presents fresh again today with the claim for Izzy Neale aiding his cause. The gear change (blinkers on) which has now been made can be of great significance! FIOGGIA endured too tough a run on debut before his subsequent Quirindi effort was game over 1100m. bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 3, 5, 6, 8, 11. ALWAYS A RAINBOW was gallant in defeat first up at Moree when she was produced over this journey with Ben Looker aboard. She can only now present race-fitter with Ben retaining the ride. FIRE 'N' STONE struck a traffic problem at Gunnedah before she refused to shirk her task on the day. She will still have scope to improve when she now presents third up. LUKE SKYWALKER was dominant when he opened his account at Quirindi and immediately taking the next step isn't beyond him. FABS CUZ begins his second campaign today. He has been given a stable change and a Gunnedah trial since his last start and whilst he will appreciate further as his preparation unfolds, this journey can be suitable first up. MISS DEE REIGN was another to strike traffic problems when she was last produced at Wyong. Switching to the country circuit can only now be regarded as a plus!

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10. MARINERA overcame a very early problem to score first up at Warren. A tongue tie has now been added to her gear and she's a lightly raced mare who should now have more to offer. ENNIROC wasn't disgraced on a heavy track at Dubbo and dropping in class today must now be regarded as a plus. MAXANDUS has been given a break since he struck traffic problems first up over this distance. He should not be harshly judged for finishing unplaced on that day. MISS MERCY was produced after a seven week break when her unplaced effort was better than it appears on paper. This much quicker back-up (eleven days) now aids her cause!
